title: USING UCC 1-308 ON MORTGAGE CLOSING DOCS
summary: Promoter recounts that his title company refused mortgage documents signed with UCC 1-308, yet claims it can still work and that mortgage loopholes exist.

assertions.quote: the lender won't accept it like this

verdicts.note: Lenders require clean signatures for funding and routinely reject annotated documents, though evidence is mostly anecdotal.

assertions.quote: of course I could have argued it of course I still could have got it through
I know many other ways y'all on loopholes how to get out of mortgage obligations

verdicts.note: Courts enforce mortgages against redemption, UCC and patent arguments; users lose homes and face fraud charges.
